title: Trade Marks (Amendment) Rules, 2025, S.I. 90 of 2025
text:
Trade Marks
BELIZE:
TRADE MARKS (AMENDMENT) RULES, 2025
ARRANGEMENT OF RULES
1. Citation.
2. Amendment of rule 16.

No. 90] Trade Marks 1
BELIZE:
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT
No. 90 of 2025
RULES made by the Minister responsible for Intellectual
Property in exercise of the powers conferred upon him
by section 71 of the Trade Marks Act, Chapter 257 of
the Substantive Laws of Belize, Revised Edition 2020,
and all other powers thereunto him enabling.
(Gazetted 18th June, 2025)
1. These Rules may be cited as the Citation.
TRADE MARKS (AMENDMENT) RULES, 2025,
and shall be read and construed as one with the Trade Marks Sub. Leg,
2020 Edn.
Rules, which, as amended, is hereinafter referred to as the
CAP. 257 p.4
principal Rules. S.I. 28 of
2022.
S.I. 63 of
2023.
S.I 110 of
2024.
2. The principal Rules are amended in rule 16(1)– Amendment of
rule 16.
(a) by inserting after paragraph (i), the following new
paragraph–
“(ia) any political party symbol, which includes
any insignia, emblem, fl ag, seal, logo, design
or name that has been used or is associated
with a political party for at least ten years
and that political party has fi elded candidates
in a General, City or Town Council Election
under the Representation of the People Act, CAP. 9.

2 Trade Marks [No. 90
CAP. 85. Belize City Council Act, Belmopan City
CAP. 86.
Council Act, Town Councils Act or Village
CAP. 87.
CAP. 88. Councils Act;”; and
(b) in paragraph (j), by deleting the words
“paragraphs (a) to (i)” and substituting the
words “paragraphs (a) to (ia)”.
MADE by the Minister responsible for intellectual property
this 18th day of June, 2025.
MR. ANTHONY G. SYLVESTRE SC
Attorney General and Minister of Legal Affairs
(Minister responsible for Intellectual Property)
